description.narrative: Sverige stöder utbildningssektorn på Tanzania Mainland genom det bilaterala stödet EPforR samt genom att vara Grant Agent för de medel som Global Partnership for Education (GPE) bidrar med till Tanzania. En ny sektorplan för hela utbildningssektorn har tagits fram. Sektorplanen är det viktigaste verktyget för att kunna planera, prioritera och genomföra utbildning de kommande fem åren. Planen ska bedömas av externa konsulter, dels för att detta ett krav från GPE inför Tanzanias kommande ansökan i september 2018 till GPE, men också för att bedöma prioriteringar, anpassning och samstämmighet med det bilaterala stödet.

Sweden is supporting the education sector on Tanzana Mainland through bilateral contribution EPforR and through the committment as a Grant Agent for the funds provided by the Global Partnership for Education to Tanzania Mainland. A new Education Sector Plan is currently being developed. The Sector Plan is the main tool for implementation in the sector according to priorities for the next five years in Education.
This is a direct procurement for the external GPE/UNESCO trained Education Sector Development Plan (ESDP) appraisal consultants. It is a direct procurement because all consultants who are supporsed to be engaged to assess, review and appraise the ESDP package are picked up from GPE list of UNESCO trained consultants. The Consultants were selected basing on their experience of perfoming similar type of assignment for GPE Zanzibar, and after showing that they are available to perfom this assignment within the GOT MOEST time limitations.
The plan should be assessed by external Consultants as a GPE requirement for the next application to GPE in August 2018, but also to assess priorities, alignment and coherence with the bilateral support.
